description: Reconcile 27 dashboard links first added directly on September 8, 2026 UTC. Replay inserts missing dated events and verifies existing ones without overwriting them.

entries.title: Over 100 rally outside the Indianapolis ICE office against increased immigration enforcement
entries.location_label: ICE office (Woodland Dr), Indianapolis, IN
entries.coordinate_note: Reuse the existing dashboard pin for the same Woodland Drive ICE office.

entries.title: Seven anti-ICE protesters, including at least six clergy, arrested for alleged trespass in Williston
entries.location_label: White Cap Business Park, Williston, VT
entries.coordinate_note: Reuse the existing White Cap Business Park surveillance-center pin; RNS confirms National Criminal Analysis and Targeting Center.

entries.title: More than 50 join an Indianapolis hotel noise protest; organizers believed ICE agents were staying there
entries.location_label: Hampton Inn, 5860 W 73rd St, Indianapolis, IN
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap way 223708984, geocoded from the hotel's verified public address. WFYI did not confirm that agents were hotel guests.

entries.title: More than 1,000 rally against ICE arrests in Danbury following A Day Without an Immigrant
entries.location_label: Danbury, CT (approximate city pin)
entries.coordinate_note: City-level location; do not imply a verified rally-stage coordinate.

entries.title: Police report 22 arrests during an anti-Islam demonstration and counterprotest outside Dearborn's council meeting
entries.location_label: Henry Ford Centennial Library, Dearborn, MI
entries.coordinate_note: Library building coordinate, OpenStreetMap way 229334816. The report does not assign all arrestees to either protest group.

entries.title: Madison encampment clearance on August 4-5 brings cumulative arrests to 22, police say
entries.location_label: Williamson and S Baldwin, Madison, WI (approximate)
entries.coordinate_note: Use the City's explicitly approximate location for the Corey Ruiz shooting site. One cumulative event, not 22 additional arrests on each date.

entries.title: Hundreds rally at Holland Park in support of immigrants and against a nearby mass-deportation event
entries.location_label: Roy G. Holland Memorial Park, Fishers, IN
entries.coordinate_note: Park-level coordinate, OpenStreetMap way 202760924; not a precise location within the rally.

entries.title: Air Force Maj. Jason Watson charged over criticism of Trump, including his July Capitol protest
entries.location_label: U.S. Capitol, Washington, DC (related protest site)
entries.coordinate_note: Pin represents the explicitly reported underlying July 1 protest site, not an unverified military charging venue. Entry date is the August 24 charging development.

entries.title: Seven Golden Gate Bridge protesters receive 30-day sentences and probation; prosecutors move to dismiss deadlocked felony charge
entries.location_label: San Francisco, CA (approximate city pin)
entries.coordinate_note: Sentencing update to the existing July verdict. City-level pin, not the bridge or an unverified courthouse location.

entries.title: Prosecutors move toward dismissing David Huerta's case under an agreement requiring continued release compliance
entries.location_label: Los Angeles, CA (approximate city pin)
entries.coordinate_note: Reuse the existing Los Angeles city-level case pin. Records the July 27 motion/agreement, not an assertion of unconditional final dismissal.

entries.title: Gwinnett County drops three traffic charges against journalist Mario Guevara; ICE detention continues
entries.location_label: Lawrenceville, GA (approximate city pin)
entries.date_note: July 10 update records dismissal; distinct from existing June 25 DeKalb protest-charge dismissal.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Nominatim city result; jurisdiction of charges, not Folkston detention site.

entries.title: Judge quashes James Queally subpoena in civil suit over journalists' Echo Park protest arrests
entries.location_label: Los Angeles, CA (approximate city pin)
entries.date_note: July 23 ruling; underlying protest occurred in 2021 and is not inserted as a new 2025 protest.
entries.coordinate_note: Existing dashboard Los Angeles city coordinates; civil proceeding, not exact courthouse.

entries.title: Charges dropped against Redbankgreen reporter Brian Donohue and publisher Kenny Katzgrau
entries.location_label: Red Bank, NJ (approximate city pin)
entries.date_note: July 24 municipal court hearing: complainant withdrew complaints about an archived police-blotter article.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Red Bank city result; not an exact court location.

entries.title: Photojournalist Carrie Schreck detained while covering an anti-ICE protest in Los Angeles
entries.location_label: Downtown Los Angeles, CA (approximate city pin)
entries.date_note: Tracker explicitly dates detention August 8; released without processing after more than two hours.
entries.coordinate_note: City-level location; route ran from Westlake Home Depot to Metropolitan Detention Center; exact arrest spot not established.

entries.title: Protesters establish a temporary encampment at Microsoft over its Israeli military contracts
entries.location_label: Microsoft East Campus, Redmond, WA (approximate campus pin)
entries.date_note: On-scene August 19 reporting; participants left the encampment after police warning. Separate from next day's arrests.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Microsoft Redmond campus result on NE One Microsoft Way; approximate campus, not exact plaza.

entries.title: Twenty arrested during protest at Microsoft over technology contracts with Israel
entries.location_label: Microsoft East Campus, Redmond, WA (approximate campus pin)
entries.date_note: On-scene August 20 report explicitly corrects the initial count of 18 arrests to 20.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Microsoft Redmond campus result; approximate campus, not exact plaza.

entries.title: Federal agents detain Angélica Guerrero during a San Francisco immigration protest
entries.location_label: ICE field office, 630 Sansome Street, San Francisco, CA
entries.date_note: KQED dates protest and detention August 20, followed by release August 21; Mission Local documents detention outside 630 Sansome.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Nominatim United States Appraisers Building at 630 Sansome Street.

entries.title: Seven arrested after occupying Microsoft President Brad Smith's office in protest over Israel contracts
entries.location_label: Microsoft headquarters, Redmond, WA (approximate campus pin)
entries.date_note: August 26 on-site press conference and police confirmation; separate office occupation from August 19-20 plaza events.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Microsoft campus reference; not the precise executive office.

entries.title: CityBeat photojournalist Lucas Griffith convicted of failure to disperse and fined $50; acquitted of other trial counts
entries.location_label: Covington, KY (approximate city pin)
entries.date_note: October 2 trial outcome is distinct from existing July 17 arrest. Tracker confirms fine and acquittals.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Covington city result; trial jurisdiction, not bridge arrest site.

entries.title: Remaining protest-related charges against CityBeat reporter Madeline Fening dismissed
entries.location_label: Covington, KY (approximate city pin)
entries.date_note: November 13 final four misdemeanor dismissals; original July 17 arrest already mapped and not re-added.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Covington city result; trial jurisdiction.

entries.title: Twelve fired FBI agents sue, alleging retaliation over kneeling during a 2020 racial justice protest
entries.location_label: Washington, DC (approximate city pin)
entries.date_note: NPR identifies lawsuit filed Monday December 8 in federal court in Washington; distinct from existing September firing entry.
entries.coordinate_note: Existing dashboard Washington city coordinates; civil filing jurisdiction, not 2020 demonstration.

entries.title: Judge temporarily blocks federal noise rule on sidewalks outside Eugene's federal building
entries.location_label: Eugene Federal Building, 211 E. 7th Avenue, OR (affected site)
entries.date_note: Article explicitly dates TRO December 10. This is a civil ruling, not criminal prosecution.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Nominatim address result for 211 East 7th Avenue; affected protest site, not claimed judge location.

entries.title: Oregon begins PCUN's Day Without an Immigrant economic boycott
entries.location_label: Oregon statewide boycott (representative Salem pin)
entries.date_note: OPB confirms first monthly boycott on December 18; later scheduled boycotts are not inferred to have occurred.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Salem city result used only as a representative state-capital pin for statewide action.

entries.title: Anti-ICE protesters buy and return ice scrapers at Ewing Home Depot
entries.location_label: Ewing Township, NJ (approximate township pin)
entries.date_note: On-scene report and photo caption date the action December 19.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Ewing Township result; exact store coordinates not established.

entries.title: Seventeen carolers protest ICE tactics outside a Naples Home Depot
entries.location_label: Naples, FL (approximate city pin)
entries.date_note: Multiple on-scene photo captions explicitly date protest December 20, four days before publication.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Nominatim Naples city result; report does not establish a particular store address.

entries.title: Christmas Day protesters rally for detained migrants outside Broward Transitional Center
entries.location_label: Broward Transitional Center, Pompano Beach, FL
entries.date_note: WSVN reports Christmas Day event on December 25; treated as one event despite aggregator describing Deerfield and Pompano separately.
entries.coordinate_note: Reused existing dashboard coordinates for same named Broward Transitional Center venue (July 5 event).

entries.title: Judge issues preliminary injunction against federal noise restrictions at Eugene protest site
entries.location_label: Eugene Federal Building, 211 E. 7th Avenue, OR (affected site)
entries.date_note: KLCC dates preliminary injunction February 20; distinct from December 10 temporary restraining order.
entries.coordinate_note: OpenStreetMap Nominatim affected federal-building address; not the judge's location.
